_comment: Creative agent execution role. Attach to dreamforge-agent-execution,
trusted by lambda.amazonaws.com (trust-lambda.json), alongside the managed
Deliberately absent: s3:DeleteObject and s3:GetObject. The agent only ever
writes new objects, so no bug or bad loop can destroy or read back the
archive — and that archive is the submission's evidence. Also absent: any
access to the users table, which belongs to the backend.
The text model is reached through a us. inference profile, which needs BOTH
the inference-profile ARN and the underlying foundation-model ARN — a call
through a profile is authorised against both. Missing the second one fails
with AccessDenied naming a model id you never asked for.
nova-canvas is listed but currently returns ResourceNotFoundException: it is
marked LEGACY and this account was not using it before the cutoff. Left in
so the agent starts illustrating the day access appears.
